svg.aria-label: A world map with one Postgres primary per region, placed on their real coordinates: Americas in New York, Europe in Paris, and India (APAC) in Mumbai. Country borders and a light sea tint come from the Natural Earth 1:50m dataset via PostGIS. A dashed circle around Western Europe marks a zoomed inset, since Paris and Amsterdam sit too close together at world scale: the inset, with French départements and the Seine, shows the global warehouse, co-located in Amsterdam, as a separate node from the Paris primary. A legend in the corner explains the pin, arrow, warehouse, and detail-area symbols.
svg.text: One writer per region: conflicts avoided by construction
